# `administration_policy_bill_links`

**Explicit administration policy bill links**

One source-stated bill link within one administration policy statement. Multiple bill links remain separate; a link does not infer support, opposition or enacted-law identity.

**Coverage.** Sampled. Explicit bill tokens in selected retained administration metadata; statements without bill links remain in administration_policy_statements. *(measured 2026-10-10)*

- **Parquet file:** `administration_policy_bill_links.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `link_id` | `VARCHAR` | Reader identity of one explicit bill link within a statement. |
| `statement_id` | `VARCHAR` | Reader identity of one statement observation within the pinned archive. |
| `source_link_index` | `BIGINT` | Position of this explicit bill token in the source statement. |
| `congress` | `BIGINT` | Congress number stated by the source; no current-Congress substitution. |
| `bill` | `VARCHAR` | Source bill token retained verbatim. |
| `native_bill_id` | `VARCHAR` | Original bill identifier from the archived metadata. |
| `bill_id` | `VARCHAR` | Reader-normalized bill identifier; an explicit link, not inferred support or opposition. |
